name: Parabens
aliases: E214, E218, E216, parabens, ethylparaben, methylparaben, propylparaben, sodium methylparaben, parabenos, metilparabeno, etilparabeno
what_is: A group of synthetic compounds widely used as chemical preservatives in food and cosmetics.
why_botia: It flags them because they are proven endocrine disruptors that mimic estrogen, directly impacting female fertility and reproductive health.
can_1: Detect E214, E218, or other declared parabens on the label.
can_2: Warn about the estrogenic activity and historical regulatory exclusions (like E216).
cannot_1: Assess the cumulative exposure or 'cocktail effect' of multiple parabens present in the diet.
cannot_2: Determine the precise concentration of the preservative in the food matrix.

sources.label: EFSA re-evaluation of parabens as food additives
WHO State of the Science of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (2012)
